status: design only; not agent-ready until prepared code/spec and native rows are independently audited
purpose: Construction manifest. Agent receives only public fields selected by arm, full original spec/source/base, and observed native rows. source_fixture is an adapter selector, not an agent field.

shared_policy.base_rows: Original public base arguments and native outputs. Source/spec unchanged; strip evaluator metadata and historical fixture IDs.
shared_policy.round1_injection: Run specified input once during preparation; freeze native output/exception with provenance. Reveal after first model response to all arms, without relation verdict, expected output, role label or the word counterexample.
shared_policy.gap_scope: Recompute each initial gap from original base arguments only using independently reviewed binding and generic dimension measurements. Preserve a false normative binding as the intentional E3 treatment while computing extras counts independently. Null predicate in E8 yields unknown, never fabricated zero. Later observations update counts cumulatively. Zero observations proves neither feasibility nor fault.
shared_policy.untrusted_notice_all_arms: Initial hypothesis is a fallible suggestion. Optional concept binding may also be wrong or underspecified. Decide from original spec and observed executions; do not assume packet is authoritative.
shared_policy.generic_arm: Same spec/source/base/native rows and initial hypothesis; omit concept_binding and abstract_gap. Expose the same raw argument/output observations from which gaps can be computed.
shared_policy.concept_arms: Add ONLY allowlisted public_catalog_projection fields from the named entry, concept_binding and recomputed abstract_gap. Never render full catalog entries. Relation+gap package intentionally supplies human-authored semantics, but no concrete counterexample, required output, native prediction, evaluator classification or fixture-specific implementation fact.

episodes.initial_hypothesis: Bất kỳ list có ít nhất hai phần tử đều bị mất ít nhất một occurrence ở output.

concept_binding.spec_quote: Preserve the number of occurrences of each value, including duplicates.

abstract_gap.unobserved_partition: at least 2 occurrences of one value

episodes.initial_hypothesis: Occurrence bằng limit bị bỏ khỏi count; khi không có equality case thì strict/inclusive comparison có thể cho cùng output.

concept_binding.spec_quote: greater than or equal to limit

abstract_gap.dimension: count of elements equal to limit

episodes.initial_hypothesis: Code dùng equality giữa hai set; điều này đủ để đáp ứng membership requirement nên không cần tìm strict-subset input.

concept_binding.spec_quote: Extra values in container are allowed.

abstract_gap.unobserved_partition: all required present and at least one extra container value
abstract_gap.fact_kind: finite sample coverage gap; this measurement does not certify the proposed relation

episodes.initial_hypothesis: Nếu eligible positive set rỗng, min có thể raise thay vì trả fallback được spec yêu cầu.

concept_binding.spec_quote: or None if no strictly positive integer exists

episodes.initial_hypothesis: Mọi input có tổng âm đều trả False do xử lý sai dấu của aggregate.

concept_binding.spec_quote: no restriction is imposed on its length

abstract_gap.unobserved_partition: length at least 3 with sum <= limit

episodes.initial_hypothesis: Deduplication là lỗi duy nhất: mọi input có các giá trị distinct đều có output đúng.

abstract_gap.unobserved_partition: positive value 1; and repeated eligible values
abstract_gap.fact_kind: two separate finite sample coverage gaps

episodes.initial_hypothesis: Local set conversion làm output mất duplicate occurrences.

abstract_gap.unobserved_partition: duplicate-containing input with native return observed
abstract_gap.fact_kind: finite sample coverage gap; no assertion of return dependency

episodes.initial_hypothesis: Implementation trả phần tử đầu tiên, nhưng spec chưa định nghĩa suitable; chưa có normative mismatch xác định.

concept_binding.spec_quote: Return the first suitable value from xs.

abstract_gap.compute_from: no executable predicate can be justified from this spec
abstract_gap.fact_kind: binding unknown, not a measured empty input partition
